=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:2131-2163 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `commit_report`, the purge-drop block (`report_purged_paths` / `git checkout HEAD~1` / amend / leased push) runs only in the `else` branch, after a direct merge is refused. When `gh pr merge "${report_pr_number}" --squash --match-head-commit "${report_head_sha}"` succeeds by putting the PR in a merge queue, the PR keeps the age-based purge deletions.
  WHY: If the report has not landed when the wait ends, the run branch is kept and the queued PR can land later with deletions based on a stale #7022 in-flight-guard answer, so an apply-analysis project dispatched in between can lose its source doc (the #7021/#7022 failure class). `test_report_pr_queued_direct_merge_is_not_reported_merged` (tests/test_workflow_log_analysis_report_pr.py:210-227) locks in this state without checking for the purge drop. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1043-1044 (also 2218-2221, 2853, 2881-2884, 3468, 3496-3498, 3579) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `commit_report` now sets `delivery` on every committed run, so the job outputs `committed` and `report_branch` are always blank. As a result, deep-audit and api-redundancy exit with `reason=no_report_branch` without pushing their sections, and `deliver-report` (gate `needs.analyze-commit-notify.outputs.committed == 'true'`) never runs.
  WHY: Every run that delivers its report pays for the deep-audit and api-redundancy LLM passes and then throws their sections away, while Telegram still announces that the audit completed. Blanking these outputs is new in this PR, so this is a regression. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:2162-2163 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When a direct merge is only queued and the report does not land within the wait, `report_merge_requested="direct"` leads to `report_delivery="pr_auto_merge"`, even though `--auto` was never armed.
  WHY: The Telegram step (sent at DEBUG) and the WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_REPORT_DELIVERY line mislabel the outcome, and nobody is alerted if the queue later ejects the PR. sonnet rated this NIT. glm noted it as a secondary defect inside its MAJOR purge-drop finding.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:2143-2223 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: After the auto-merge-pending branch restores the purged docs and amends the commit, `purged_docs_list` is not cleared, so `echo "purged_docs=${purged_docs_list}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"` (and the job output at line 1045) still names docs this run kept.
  WHY: Consumers of `purged_docs` (including the `PURGED_DOCS` env on deliver-report) are told the docs were deleted, which contradicts the `WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_PURGE_SKIPPED reason=auto_merge_pending` log line. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:2144-2159 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: If the purge-drop fails (checkout HEAD~1, amend, or leased force-push), the step warns that "a stale purge cannot land later". But the remote run branch still holds the commit with the deletions and the PR stays open.
  WHY: A manual merge or a repository-level auto-merge can still land the stale purge deletions, which violates the project #9116 safety contract and leaves the #7022 failure mode reachable. Both reviewers rated it NIT.
- tests/test_workflow_log_analysis_report_pr.py:test_report_pr_auto_merge_drops_purge_deletions | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `assert calls[2] == f"pr merge 42 --auto --squash --match-head-commit {branch_head}", calls` indexes `calls[2]` without first asserting `len(calls) == 3`, unlike the sibling tests.
  WHY: A regression in the gh call sequence shows up as an IndexError instead of an assertion that prints the recorded calls. Both reviewers rated it NIT.
- tests/test_workflow_log_analysis_failure_contract.py:514 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The test module is missing `import Path`.
  WHY: gemini says the module will raise NameError on execution (MAJOR). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disputes this: it says the file already imports Path (line 10, `from pathlib import Path`) and that the finding is invalid.
- agents.d/analysis-findings-p1-report-pr.md:2-3 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The prefix registry carries two conflicting descriptions of `WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_REPORT_DELIVERY`. The new p1 fragment conflicts with agents.d/8963-log-analysis-report-pr-delivery.md line 6 (`outcome=pr_opened branch=<b> pr=<n> file=<path>`), and that old shape can no longer be emitted by any reachable path.
  WHY: Consumers keyed on `branch=` or `outcome=pr_opened` stop matching, while the folded registry advertises both shapes as current and documents deliver-report failure modes for a path that can no longer run. Both reviewers rated it NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The plan (docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md, P1) requires the deep-audit and api-redundancy section jobs to push their section commits to the run branch, and a `publish-report` job to open one PR from the run branch to the dispatch branch and produce the `workflow-log-analysis-report-final` artifact.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml: the `analyze-commit-notify` job outputs (`committed` / `report_branch`, lines 1043-1045), the section push steps (`Commit and push deep audit section` 2853/2881, `Commit and push API redundancy section` 3468/3496), the `deliver-report` job condition (3579), and the missing `publish-report` job
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No run branch is passed to the section jobs, because `committed: ${{ steps.commit_report.outputs.delivery == '' && steps.commit_report.outputs.committed || '' }}` and `report_branch` are blanked on every default-mode run. Both section steps end at `WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_REPORT_DELIVERY outcome=skipped reason=no_report_branch` (workflow-log-analysis.yml:2882 job=deep-audit, 3497 job=api-redundancy). The `deliver-report` `if` at 3579 can never be true, so `scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh` cannot run. No `publish-report` job exists in the job list (collect-logs, weekly-retro, analyze-commit-notify, deep-audit, api-redundancy, deliver-report). No `workflow-log-analysis-report-final` artifact is produced; only `workflow-log-analysis-report` is uploaded. minimax says this predates the LAST RUN DIFF.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:2132-2161 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The purge-drop block runs only in the else-branch (2137-2160). The direct path `if gh pr merge "${report_pr_number}" --squash --match-head-commit "${report_head_sha}"; then report_merge_requested="direct"` (2132-2135) skips it, so a PR that a merge queue accepts keeps the purge deletions. `test_report_pr_queued_direct_merge_is_not_reported_merged` has no check for the purge drop.
  WHY: The queued squash lands later with deletions based on a stale guard answer, so an apply-analysis project can lose its source doc (#7021/#7022). Suggested fix: run the purge-drop block before the first `gh pr merge` call.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1043-1044 (also 2853, 2881-2884, 3468, 3497, 3579) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `delivery` is always set, so `committed` and `report_branch` are always empty. deep-audit and api-redundancy exit 0 with `reason=no_report_branch` without pushing, and deliver-report never runs.
  WHY: Each delivered run pays for the LLM passes and then discards their sections, while Telegram still announces that the audit completed. This is a regression introduced by this PR, not a deferred item.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:2162-2163 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A queued direct merge that does not land in time is recorded as `pr_auto_merge` even though `--auto` was never armed.
  WHY: The Telegram step and the WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_REPORT_DELIVERY line mislabel the outcome, and nobody is alerted if the queue ejects the PR.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:2143-2153 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `purged_docs_list` is not cleared after the deletions are restored, so the `purged_docs` output (and the job output at line 1045) still names kept docs.
  WHY: Consumers are told the docs were deleted, which contradicts the auto_merge_pending skip line.
- tests/test_workflow_log_analysis_report_pr.py:test_report_pr_auto_merge_drops_purge_deletions | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `calls[2]` is indexed without first checking `len(calls)`, as Copilot entry[16] also noted.
  WHY: A regression shows up as an IndexError instead of an assertion that prints the recorded calls.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:2132 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: A successful squash merge records `report_merge_requested="direct"` and skips the purge-deletion removal (2140-2157), which is restricted to the failure branch.
  WHY: When the merge queue accepts the PR, the stale purge deletions can land later, and an apply-analysis project can lose a doc it needs.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1043-1044 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `committed` and `report_branch` are gated on `delivery == ''`, and PR mode always sets `delivery`.
  WHY: This breaks the downstream contract for deliver-report, deep-audit, and api-redundancy, which never receive the branch context.
- tests/test_workflow_log_analysis_failure_contract.py:514 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Path is not imported.
  WHY: The test module will raise NameError on execution.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:2145-2157 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When the purge-drop fails, the PR stays open with a warning that claims "a stale purge cannot land later".
  WHY: A manual or repository-level auto-merge can still land the stale deletions, which violates the #9116 safety contract.
- agents.d/analysis-findings-p1-report-pr.md:2-3 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The registry has two conflicting descriptions of the WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_REPORT_DELIVERY prefix.
  WHY: Consumers keyed on the old format stop matching.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Implement the deep-audit and api-redundancy run-branch commit pushing; implement a new publish-report job that opens one PR from the run branch to the dispatch branch; produce the workflow-log-analysis-report-final artifact.
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml: job outputs (1043-1045), section push steps (2853/2881, 3468/3496), and a publish-report job.
  Evidence of absence: No run branch is passed to the section jobs, there is no publish-report job, deliver-report is unreachable, no final artifact is produced, and the section pushes fail with WORKFLOW_LOG_ANALYSIS_REPORT_DELIVERY outcome=skipped reason=no_report_branch.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
